content.short: Combining the Internet of Things (IoT) with the Cardano Blockchain and having fun in the process.
content.description:
CardanoThings.io provides a series of workshops combining ESP32 Microcontrollers with Cardano, so people can learn how to build physical integrations utilizing blockchain technology. We teach everything from the very basics of setting up your ESP32 microcontroller with the Arduino IDE to more complex use cases with your own NodeJS based APIs, creating transactions with the MeshJS SDK or utilizing existing Cardano tools like Koios, Blockfrost, Charli3, CardanoScan and others.

While these workshops are aimed at beginners, we hope to inspire developers and interested users from both the IoT and Cardano community to come up with new and fun use cases and share them with each other.
